arxiv-2106-11078.title: Poisson groupoids and moduli spaces of flat bundles over surfaces
arxiv-2106-11078.creator: Daniel Álvarez
arxiv-2106-11078.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Daniel Álvarez. Let Σ \Sigma be a compact connected and oriented surface with nonempty boundary and let G G be a Lie group equipped with a bi-invariant pseudo-Riemannian metric. The moduli space of flat principal G G -bundles over Σ \Sigma which are trivialized at a finite subset of ∂ Σ \partial\Sigma carries a natural quasi-Hamiltonian structure which was introduced by Li-Bland and Ševera.

arxiv-2110-00165.title: Large-scale ASR Domain Adaptation Using Self- and Semi-supervised Learning
arxiv-2110-00165.creator: Dongseong Hwang, Ananya Misra, Zhouyuan Huo, Nikhil Siddhartha, Shefali Garg, David Qiu, Khe Chai Sim, Trevor Strohman, Françoise Beaufays, Yanzhang He
arxiv-2110-00165.description: Abstract Self- and semi-supervised learning methods have been actively investigated to reduce labeled training data or enhance model performance. However, these approaches mostly focus on in-domain performance for public datasets. In this study, we utilize the combination of self- and semi-supervised learning methods to solve unseen domain adaptation problems in a large-scale production setting for online ASR model.

arxiv-2111-05570.title: Tuning the Fermi Liquid Crossover in Sr 2 RuO 4 {}_{4}\, with Uniaxial Stress
arxiv-2111-05570.creator: A. Chronister, M. Zingl, A. Pustogow, Yongkang Luo, D. A. Sokolov, F. Jerzembeck, N. Kikugawa, C. W. Hicks, J. Mravlje, E. D. Bauer, A. P. Mackenzie, A. Georges, S. E. Brown
arxiv-2111-05570.description: Abstract We perform nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) measurements of the oxygen-17 Knight shifts for Sr 2 RuO 4 {}_{4}\, , while subjected to uniaxial stress applied along [100] direction. The resulting strain is associated with a strong variation of the temperature and magnetic field dependence of the inferred magnetic response.

arxiv-2305-06048.description: Abstract Millimeter wave (mmWave) communications has been recently standardized for use in the fifth generation (5G) of cellular networks, fulfilling the promise of multi-gigabit mobile throughput of current and future mobile radio network generations. In this context, the network densification required to overcome the difficult mmWave propagation will result in increased deployment costs.

arxiv-2307-01740.title: Synchronous Image-Label Diffusion Probability Model with Application to Stroke Lesion Segmentation on Non-contrast CT
arxiv-2307-01740.creator: Jianhai Zhang 1 Tonghua Wan 2 Ethan MacDonald 1 Bijoy Menon 1, Aravind Ganesh 1 Qiu Wu 2
arxiv-2307-01740.description: Abstract Stroke lesion volume is a key radiologic measurement for assessing the prognosis of Acute Ischemic Stroke (AIS) patients, which is challenging to be automatically measured on Non-Contrast CT (NCCT) scans. Recent diffusion probabilistic models have shown potentials of being used for image segmentation.

arxiv-2307-11600.title: Optical pumping enhancement of a free-induction-decay magnetometer Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2307-11600.creator: Dominic Hunter, Marcin S. Mrozowski, Allan McWilliam, Stuart J. Ingleby, Terry E. Dyer, Paul F. Griffin, Erling Riis
arxiv-2307-11600.description: Abstract Spin preparation prior to a free-induction-decay (FID) measurement can be adversely affected by transverse bias fields, particularly in the geophysical field range. A strategy that enhances the spin polarization accumulated before readout is demonstrated, by synchronizing optical pumping with a magnetic field pulse that supersedes any transverse fields by over two order of magnitude.

arxiv-2409-20476.description: Abstract Modern high-end systems are increasingly becoming heterogeneous, providing users options to use general purpose Graphics Processing Units (GPU) and other accelerators for additional performance. arxiv-2510-03645.creator: Guy Blanc Stanford Caleb Koch Stanford Jane Lange MIT Carmen Strassle Stanford Li-Yang Tan Stanford
arxiv-2510-03645.description: Abstract We give new evidence that quantum circuits are substantially more powerful than classical circuits. We show, relative to a random oracle, that polynomial-size quantum circuits can sample distributions that subexponential-size classical circuits cannot approximate even to TV distance 1 − o ⁡ ( 1 ) 1-o(1) .

pmc-10748078.title: Design, Fabrication, and Characterization of a Novel Optical Six-Axis Distributed Force and Displacement Tactile Sensor for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
pmc-10748078.creator: Olivia Leslie, David Córdova Bulens, Stephen J. Redmond
pmc-10748078.description: Real-time multi-axis distributed tactile sensing is a critical capability if robots are to perform stable gripping and dexterous manipulation, as it provides crucial information about the sensor–object interface. In this paper, we present an optical-based six-axis tactile sensor designed in a fingertip shape for robotic dexterous manipulation.

pmc-11435755.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The organic coating on the surface is common and the most effective method to prevent metal materials from corrosion. However, the corrosive medium can penetrate the metal surface via micropores, and electrons cannot transfer in the pure resin coatings.

pmc-11642935.title: Role of Multimodality Imaging in Cardiac Sarcoidosis: A Retrospective Single-Center Experience
pmc-11642935.creator: Vincent A. Torelli, Sanjay Sivalokanathan, Alexander Silverman, Syed Zaidi, Usman Saeedullah, Komail Jafri, James Choi, Luka Katic, Serdar Farhan, Ashish Correa
pmc-11642935.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: Cardiac sarcoidosis (CS) is a rare entity characterized by granulomatous infiltration of the myocardium, which can lead to myocardial fibrosis, conduction abnormalities, and the development of heart failure, thereby elevating the risk of sudden cardiac death (SCD). While endomyocardial biopsy (EMBx) is regarded as the gold standard for diagnosis, its low sensitivity and inherent procedural risks may limit its practical application.

pmc-12528317.title: TCBLex - A lexical database of Finnish literary texts for children
pmc-12528317.creator: Tapio Nojonen, Kiia Korsu, Filip Ginter, Veronika Laippala, Jenna Kanerva
pmc-12528317.description: This work introduces TCBLex, a lexical database of Finnish literary works read by children between the ages of 7 and 15. We explain in detail the work done to build the corpus TCBLex is based on, including how books were sampled and collected, turned into text files, and finally processed.

pmc-12750684.title: Evaluating quality of care for dying patients from the perspective of bereaved relatives: validation of the Chinese version of the international care of the dying evaluation
pmc-12750684.creator: Xuejiao Zheng, Liying Zhou, Baiyan Li, Lei Dong, Yuna Li, Catriona R Mayland, Maho Aoyama, Mitsunori Miyashita
pmc-12750684.description: BackgroundFew recognized, valid and reliable tools are used to assess the current quality of care at the very end-of-life from the bereaved relative’s perspective in Mainland China. The purpose of this study was to validate the Chinese version of the international Care Of the Dying Evaluation (i-CODE) questionnaire by assessing its reliability and validity.

pmc-12972596.title: Past Colony Connectivity of a Declining Seabird Derived From Host–Parasite Genetic Data
pmc-12972596.creator: C. P. Cargill, K. D. McCoy, B. E. Scott, E. A. Masden, J. Miller, L. Ruffino, A. Payo‐Payo
pmc-12972596.description: The black‐legged kittiwake ( Rissa tridactyla , hereafter ‘kittiwake’, conservation status ‘Vulnerable’) is a long‐lived, highly motile and wide‐ranging seabird. Breeding kittiwake colonies are abundant across the northern hemisphere. The kittiwake's life history and the spatial scale of its breeding distribution make understanding colony connectivity a challenge; current species management models kittiwake colonies as closed units.

pmc-13221637.title: Impact of SARS-CoV-2 Breakthrough Infection on Short-Term CD4 Count Among Adults With HIV in the United States From 2020 to 2022
pmc-13221637.creator: Lincoln Hopkins, Elizabeth Humes, Kirsha S Gordon, Vincent C Marconi, Raynell Lang, Michael A Horberg, Sonia Napravnik, Michael J Silverberg, Lindsay E Browne, Lesley S Park, Kelly A Gebo, Deana M Agil, Keri N Althoff, Sally B Coburn
pmc-13221637.description: BackgroundCD4 T cells are critical for reducing disease severity and viral clearance of SARS-CoV-2, which is particularly important among populations that are immune compromised, including people with HIV (PWH). While vaccines are effective, risk and severity of COVID-19 breakthrough infections are higher in people with vs without HIV.

pmc-13275009.title: Earliest Jurassic plant assemblages from Sweden reveal a low-diversity ginkgoalean and cheirolepid flora dominating the post-extinction landscape
pmc-13275009.creator: Daniela Quiroz-Cabascango, Vivi Vajda, Stephen McLoughlin, Grzegorz Niedźwiedzki
pmc-13275009.description: Background and AimsRich Triassic–Jurassic plant assemblages from Skåne, southern Sweden, have been documented extensively over the past two centuries. However, no macrofloras from the lowermost part of the Helsingborg Member (Lower Jurassic) have been forthcoming and thus the age of the successions has not been well constrained.

pmc-13332739.title: Delivery of TCM Monomers Using Blood Cell Membrane Coated Biomimetic Nanoparticles to Target CVD
pmc-13332739.creator: Jia-Qi Xi, Jia-Qi Zhang, Yuan-Jia-Yi Shen, Zhou-Yu Nie, Yang Shen, Yong-Bing Cao, Li-Chao Zhang, Ling Li
pmc-13332739.description: Cell membrane-coated nanoparticles are receiving increasing recognition for their potential in treating cardiovascular diseases (CVD). This novel drug delivery system, featuring drug-loaded nanoparticles modified by naturally derived cell membranes, is capable of precisely targeting diseased sites, improving drug bioavailability, evading immune surveillance, and prolonging half-life.

pmc-13495614.title: Epidemiology of appendicitis in Ecuador, 2004–2024: a national time-series analysis of incidence, trends, geographic variation, and case-fatality rates
pmc-13495614.creator: Esteban Ortiz-Prado, Micaela Vergara, María Gabriela Dávila Rosero, Jorge Vasconez-Gonzalez, Paul Astudillo Neira, Juan S Izquierdo-Condoy
pmc-13495614.description: SummaryBackgroundAppendicitis is a common surgical emergency and a leading cause of gastrointestinal hospital admission in Ecuador. However, its long-term national patterns have not been comprehensively characterized. We aimed to describe appendicitis-related hospital discharge rates, temporal and geographic variation, and in-hospital case-fatality in Ecuador during 2004–2024.

pmc-13545111.title: Myopia Awareness in Australia: Insights from a Nationwide Survey
pmc-13545111.creator: Mimi Vi, Isabelle Jalbert, Luke Arundel, Alex Huynh, Timothy Li, Pauline Kang

pmc-13573789.title: Humanistic Care Needs of Elderly Chronic Disease Inpatients from the Perspective of Patient Journey Mapping: A Qualitative Study
pmc-13573789.creator: Jing Zhao, Yuelin Zhang, Ge Bai, Yancen Wu, Tao Xue, Yanli Wang
pmc-13573789.description: PurposeBased on patient journey maps, this study identified the behavioral challenges and needs for compassionate care among older inpatients with chronic diseases at different stages of diagnosis and treatment, and explored the pain points and preferences in their care experiences, thereby providing targeted insights to optimize compassionate care practices, enhance continuity of care, and improve patients’ quality of life.

pmc-13626210.title: Coding, modifier, and regulatory effects shape circulating APOL1 levels
pmc-13626210.creator: Walt E Adamson, Harry Noyes, John Ogunsola, Rulan S Parekh, Anneli Cooper, Annette MacLeod
pmc-13626210.description: APOL1 variants G1 and G2 are major genetic risk factors for chronic kidney disease in people with recent sub-Saharan African ancestry, yet the mechanisms linking genotype to disease remain poorly defined. Circulating APOL1 is likely to play a critical role, although how specific genotypes and regulatory variants influence circulating APOL1 levels is incompletely understood.
